messages.content: Help me implement a 'dataFetch' operation with an API endpoint URL of 'https://api.example.com/data', expecting the response to be a JSON object containing '{"key": "value"}', given a request configuration object '{"method": "GET"}'?

function.name: performDataFetch
function.description: This function fetches data from a specified API endpoint using the provided request configuration, checks the response against an expected JSON object, and handles any potential errors. It supports various request methods like GET or POST. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

apiEndpoint.description: The URL of the API endpoint from which the data will be fetched. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

requestConfig.description: The configuration object for the API request. This is JavaScript dict type parameter in string representation. The dictionary entries have the following schema; they are not in string representation. {"method": {"type": "String", "description": "The HTTP method to be used for the request."}, "headers": {"type": "dict", "description": "Any headers to be included in the request."}, "body": {"type": "String", "description": "The request payload, if needed for methods like POST."}}

expectedResponse.description: The JSON object expected to be returned by the API call. This is JavaScript dict type parameter in string representation.

handleErrors.description: If true, the function will handle errors gracefully and provide appropriate feedback. Default false This is JavaScript Boolean type parameter in string representation.
